subject: Who will publish invoices / delivery channel choice (portal vs email)
messages:
From: Lisa Mercado <lisa.mercado@starksolutions.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice publishing — who is the issuer and delivery preferences?

Hi Connor,

Quick question as we finalize setup: for Stark Solutions' account who at Redwood will be the official invoice publisher (the 'From' on the invoice)? We need this for our AP system mapping. Also - what delivery channels do you support (portal, email PDF, SFTP)? We have a couple of constraints:

- We require VAT tagging on each invoice line (reverse charge not applicable for this account).
- We usually start with email copies and then enroll the supplier into our portal once production invoices begin.

Can you also send a sample invoice and the signed SOW so our AP team can validate field mappings? If portal is possible, what is the expected enrollment lead time?

Thanks,
Lisa Mercado
AP Manager, Stark Solutions
accounts-payable@starksolutions.com

Attachment: Stark_PO_998271.xml (PO sample)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Mercado <lisa.mercado@starksolutions.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice publishing — who is the issuer and delivery preferences?

Hi Lisa,

Thanks — forwarding to our billing ops to confirm the authoritative issuer and delivery path. I've cc'd Kimberly from Billing and Marissa on the contract side in case there are any SOW-specific fields we need to include.

Short answer: we can publish from Redwood Inference (Redwood Inference Inc.). We support portal enrollment + email PDF copies, SFTP/webhook pushes for higher-volume customers, and can include VAT fields per-line.

Kimberly — can you take point and share a sample invoice and enrollment timeline? Also recommend a two-month email-copy transition during portal activation unless AP asks otherwise.

Connor
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

On 2028-06-20 14:12, Lisa Mercado wrote:
> Quick question as we finalize setup: for Stark Solutions' account who at Redwood will be the official invoice publisher (the 'From' on the invoice)?
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Mercado <lisa.mercado@starksolutions.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice publishing — who is the issuer and delivery preferences?

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and the PO sample. Looping in Vivek for compliance notes (VAT proofing). Below is a concise plan and the options so your AP can pick the simplest path.

Summary of options (recommended in bold):

1) Portal-first (recommended for long-term):
   - Redwood will publish invoices from: Redwood Inference Inc. (EIN available on request).
   - Delivery: invoices pushed into your supplier portal. We provide a PDF copy via email for the first 2 months while you validate mappings.
   - Timeline: typical portal onboarding 7–14 business days after we exchange enrollment metadata.
   - VAT: we will include per-line VAT tags and a top-level VAT summary. Provide your AP field names and we will map them.

2) Email-first (short-term / low volume):
   - Redwood sends signed PDF invoices to accounts-payable@starksolutions.com.
   - We can embed machine-readable invoice metadata (UBL/AI) if your AP system parses attachments.
   - Timeline: immediate; no portal work.

3) SFTP / API push (high volume):
   - We can push XML/UBL to an SFTP endpoint or webhook.
   - Requires endpoint details and a short security checklist.

Requested info from Stark to proceed:
- PO mapping: which PO fields must land in your AP system (PO number, cost center, project code)?
- VAT handling: confirm if you want a separate VAT line or per-line VAT tag (you indicated per-line).
- Portal contact: name/email for enrollment and a preferred cutover date window.

Attachments included: Redwood_sample_invoice_v1.pdf (sample invoice layout) and SOW_redwood-stark_signed.pdf (signed SOW excerpt for required invoice fields).

If you'd like, we can set a 30-minute sync tomorrow to finalize cutover and field mapping. Let me know preferred time.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_sample_invoice_v1.pdf; SOW_redwood-stark_signed.pdf
From: Lisa Mercado <lisa.mercado@starksolutions.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-23T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice publishing — who is the issuer and delivery preferences?

Hi Kimberly (and team),

Thanks — portal-first with two months of email copies sounds good.

Answers to your questions:
- PO mapping: our AP requires PO number (field PO_NUM), cost center (COST_CTR), and project code (PRJ_CODE).
- VAT handling: please include per-line VAT tags; also add a top-level VAT total.
- Portal contact: I (lisa.mercado@starksolutions.com) will be the enrollment contact. Preferred cutover window: 2028-07-15 to 2028-07-22.

We reviewed the sample invoice and the SOW looks fine. Please proceed with portal enrollment and confirm a time for a short mapping call next week — mornings (09:00–11:00 PT) work best.

One more ask: can you add the Redwood tax registration number on the invoice header? Our AP will need that for reconciliation.

Lisa
AP Manager, Stark Solutions
